page: Microsoft Azure NC8ads_A10_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 AMD processor, the instance allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs alongside 100.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware-accelerated computing is supplied by a single dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM.

The virtual machine incorporates 773 GB of local SSD temporary storage, providing low-latency disk access for scratch space, caching, and transient files, while also supporting Azure Premium Storage volumes. Network configurations require external IP allocation, as the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its combination of an NVIDIA A10 accelerator, substantial RAM, and fast local SSD storage, the NC8ads_A10_v4 offers an efficient hardware profile for deep learning inference, video transcoding, visual workstation tasks, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
